source_snapshot.items: NV Cable validation setup and trial run - Cable validation
source_snapshot.procedure: Open UFM System Health > Fabric Validation, select each left-bar `Check xxx` item one by one and inspect the center-pane result.
source_snapshot.criteria: Each item displays PASS; any warning is investigated against the corresponding item.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL/CONFLICTING; preserves only generic UFM access and adds unrelated subnet-merger deployment risk without enumerating or evidencing cable checks.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CHANGED; requires release-specific checklist, item-level evidence, topology mapping and warning disposition.

old_problem: The active record kept the case pending because item names vary by UFM release. NVIDIA documents the System Health validation categories and itemized report model; the complete visible release-matched catalog can be captured before execution. Dynamic catalog discovery is safer and more complete than hard-coding another release's list.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA System Health documentation defines Fabric Validation/Health checks and itemized results, including cable diagnostics, link speed/width, BER and physical port-grade checks. ED-03 permits target/release/topology bindings, ED-08 requires actual UI evidence, ED-09 keeps physical warning investigation manual, and ED-16 holds unknown or mutating checks. Capturing the entire current UI catalog, classifying each item from its built-in description and running every approved read-only cable item once preserves the source's 'one by one' coverage without inventing omitted names.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row422 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3014, completed baseline row423 and next pending row424.
Applied NVIDIA UFM System Health documentation for versioned validation/report items and cable/link/BER/physical-grade categories.
Required a captured release-specific full UI checklist before selecting checks, avoiding both omitted items and guessed names.
Converted warning acceptance into per-item report, GUID/port/cable mapping and owner disposition; no automatic remediation or topology action is allowed.
Directly read row423 as already completed baseline and row424 as the next pending manifest identity; no UFM check or fabric action ran.

test_case.test_name: Release-discovered item-by-item UFM cable and link validation
test_case.purpose: Run every applicable read-only cable/link validation exposed by the approved UFM release and prove each item passes or has a cable-specific warning fully mapped and dispositioned without changing fabric state.
required_package: Approved UFM endpoint/version/account and designated fabric/topology snapshot
Complete captured Fabric Validation UI item catalog with descriptions and read-only/disruptive classification for that exact release
Switch/HCA GUID, port, peer, cable serial/label/type/speed/width map
Warning exception authority, qualified physical cable observer and escalation owner
test_case.test_command: Capture UFM/version/fabric/topology/alarms and the complete visible Fabric Validation left-bar catalog with each item's description. Build an execution ledger in UI order; run once every item whose documented scope is cable type/diagnostics, link speed/width, BER/signal integrity or physical port grade and is confirmed read-only. For each, preserve start/end, report ID, status, full detail and affected GUID/port/cable. Hold rather than run any unknown or mutating item. Map every warning to physical identity/counters and obtain explicit owner disposition; do not remediate.
test_case.expected_result: The ledger accounts for every current UI item and every applicable approved cable check completes. Each required item reports PASS; any warning remains non-PASS until its exact GUID/port/cable, raw measurements and approved exception are documented. No topology, port state, routing, configuration or active job changes.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the complete versioned catalog, per-item reports/status/details, all applicable cable items executed exactly once, no unresolved warning/error and unchanged fabric state. A single aggregate PASS, omitted checkbox, unidentified warning or unknown item executed without semantics cannot pass.
safety_gate: Capture and read each item's release-specific description before execution; run only confirmed read-only checks
Do not invoke corrective, topology, port-state, firmware or cable-remediation actions
Preserve existing alarms/logs and full report detail; do not clear or acknowledge evidence
Stop on unknown/mutating semantics, new critical alarm, fabric/job impact or management loss; never auto-retry
expected_evidence: UFM version/fabric/topology/alarms baseline and complete UI item catalog screenshots/export
Ordered item ledger with applicability and read-only authority
Per-item timestamps, report IDs, status, full details and real UI screenshots
GUID/port/peer/cable-label map and measurement evidence for each warning
Warning dispositions, unchanged topology/post-health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No state change is expected. On unknown behavior or fabric impact, stop the current validation, preserve the report and alarms, verify UFM/OpenSM/topology/link health and escalate without remediation or retry. Physical cable work belongs to a separately authorized action.
